summary: A single requirements.yml can have roles and collections sections; role versions don't support ranges while collection versions do.
questions: Can I install roles and collections from the same file?
Can I use version ranges for roles in requirements.yml?

answer_card.title: Roles and collections in one file
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
roles:
  - name: geerlingguy.java
    version: "1.9.6"     # ranges not supported for roles
collections:
  - name: community.general
    version: ">=7.0.0"
    source: https://galaxy.ansible.com
```
